notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello citizens of Gamarket! We have an update on a new patch for Hyperdevotion Noire: Goddess Black Heart!

-Fixed an issue where right-clicking on an enemy stops their movement.
-Enabled face-button remapping on controller devices.


For any other issues, please post in the pinned support thread or e-mail pcsupport@ideafintl.com.
